title: Presheaf diagonal and separated morphisms on scheme tests
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Let $G,F$ be presheaves of sets on schemes over $S$, with the test schemes and universes of [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $g:G\to F$ be a morphism. Its diagonal $\delta_g:G\to G\times_FG$ is the unique map to the presheaf fibre product whose two projections are $\operatorname{id}_G$. Say that $g$ is separated if $\delta_g$ is representable by closed immersions: for every scheme $T$ over $S$ and every map $h_T\to G\times_FG$, the presheaf fibre product $h_T\times_{G\times_FG}G$ is represented by a scheme $V$ over $S$ whose projection $V\to T$ is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], in the sense of representability with a scheme-test property of [def-trf-algebraic-space].
